newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank drains SKK450mln in tender, rate up.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank drains SKK450mln in tender, rate up.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday it had drained funds totalling 450 million crowns through a seven-day securities reverse repurchase tender.
The NBS said in a statement the average rate was 14.65 percent, after 14.60 percent in the previous successful reverse repo tender with a seven-day maturity on Friday.
The maximum bid in the tender was 15.0 percent, while the minimum bid rate was 12.95 percent, it added.
A week ago, the NBS said yields should drop. Until then, NBS reverse repo rates had been declining for one week due to lower bids by commercial banks.
The NBS said 450 million crowns worth of bids out of a total 1.33 billion were accepted.
